projectDescription: A non-custodial fiat ↔ crypto on/off-ramp that lets users buy and sell ZEC, SOL, ETH, USDC, and other assets against local payment rails (BRL via Pix) using P2P.me identity/escrow and NEAR Intents for asset conversion.
keyFeatures: Non-custodial: 0xramp never holds user funds, keys, or Pix credentials
Buy crypto (ZEC, SOL, ETH, USDC, NEAR Intents assets) with BRL via Pix
Sell crypto and receive BRL via Pix
P2P.me-powered identity, reputation, limits, KYC, and USDC escrow on Base
NEAR Intents handles USDC → target asset conversion
Login via P2P.me smart account (gas-sponsored) or external wallets (Rabby, Phantom)
On-chain order placement — no 0xramp custody of funds
Transparent fee breakdown shown before confirmation
Per-order and daily limits driven by P2P.me on-chain reputation
publicApiSurface: Buy flow: fiat amount → quote → Pix QR → asset delivery to wallet address
Sell flow: asset send → Pix payment received
P2P.me login (smart account) — gas-sponsored, no seed phrase required
Quote breakdown: fixed fee, asset conversion fee, exchange rate spread
Refund address for failed or expired orders
Supported chains: Zcash, Solana, Ethereum, Base
Supported assets: ZEC, SOL, ETH, USDC, NEAR Intents catalog
Supported fiat corridor: BRL via Pix (Brazil)
